content.text: Pre-excited AF, hemodynamically stable: ibutilide or IV procainamide = beneficial.
Stable wide-complex (antidromic) tachy after failed vagal maneuvers: IV procainamide, IV amiodarone or synchronized cardioversion.
AF + WPW: ⍉digoxin, adenosine or NDHP CCBs (may trigger VF).
